title: Meatball Sub Casserole
description: Start with frozen meatballs, prepared sauce, and a loaf of frozen garlic bread and serve your family this fun and hearty meatball casserole just a few minutes later. It's perfect for game day.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C).
Heat garlic bread with spread side up on a baking sheet in the preheated oven until warm and golden brown, 10 to 12 minutes. Set aside to cool.
Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Bring spaghetti sauce to a boil in a large pot. Place frozen meatballs into sauce. Reduce heat to low and simmer until meatballs are heated through, about 20 minutes.

Tear garlic bread into bite-size pieces and spread into bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish. Pour spaghetti sauce and meatballs over garlic bread, coating bread with sauce and distributing meatballs evenly. Spread mozzarella cheese over top in a layer, followed by a layer of Parmesan cheese.
Bake casserole until cheese has melted, 20 to 25 minutes.

video.description: Please everyone at your next neighborhood potluck or football tailgate party with this scrumptious and saucy meat and cheese extravaganza! Begin by baking up some garlic bread, then simmering frozen meatballs in a rich tomato spaghetti sauce. Next, tear up the garlic bread and add to a casserole dish. Top with loads of mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses and bake until everything is gooey and melted over the garlicky toasted crust. No one will be able to resist a whole baking dish of their favorite meatball sub sandwich, deconstructed!
